name: engine-stripping
title: Engine stripping: build a game without the engine modules it does not use, every module, on web and native (six stages; stage 1 is the mechanism and physics)
issue: User request, 2026-11-08: 'make engine stripping when engines are not used, for example if a game doesn't use physics or doesn't use 2D physics in particular'. User decisions the same day: an explicit per-project module list with a scan that suggests and checks it; web and native; all modules; after Physics2D stage 2. Design and stage table: orchestrator/proposals/engine-stripping-design.md. Stage 1 implements J10 of the physics plan. Split into one item per stage before launching.
acceptance: For each stage's modules, a game can be built with the module left out, on the web and natively; CI builds one configuration per module off and one minimal configuration with all off
A stripped build given a scene that needs a stripped module fails with a clear message at package or build time, and at run time if it gets that far
The measured size of each configuration is recorded; the full build's behaviour and budgets are unchanged
gate: split per stage; stage 1 is engine-stripping-p1-physics. Each later stage needs the user's go.
notes: Reviewer: a stripped module leaves no symbols behind, a full build is unchanged, and the network fingerprint is defined for a stripped player.
